observability_triage.rationale: Battery-plug accessibility is an objective clearance question only when the battery connector, USB-C connector, cable insertion envelope, and enclosure opening are all modeled in one coordinate system. The current PCB has no enclosure-opening or mating-cable geometry and its generic footprints do not expose usable courtyards.
interfaces_inspected: dist/design.kicad_pcb footprint positions and board outline
repair_requirements: Add enclosure CAD or a frozen keep-out polygon for the USB-C case opening in PCB coordinates.
Add real J_BAT and USB-C footprints with placed courtyard and mating-direction geometry.
Define a cable insertion/service envelope and minimum clearance predicate.

evidence: No enclosure opening is present in the repository.
No battery-cable insertion envelope is defined.
Generic footprint origins cannot establish cable accessibility.
minimum_environment_repairs: Add enclosure CAD or a frozen keep-out polygon for the USB-C case opening in PCB coordinates.
Add real J_BAT and USB-C footprints with placed courtyard and mating-direction geometry.
Define a cable insertion/service envelope and minimum clearance predicate.
blocker_or_exclusion.reentry_condition: Re-author after the case opening and battery-cable service envelope are frozen and co-registered with real PCB footprints.

uncovered_items.evidence: The board artifact lacks the external mechanical geometry needed to test obstruction.
uncovered_items.required_action: Repair the stated artifact surface before validator authoring.
